{{Quote|Wait. I've got a sensor contact. It's pretty far out but...|Esrai's last words|<ref name="Razor's Edge" />}}
'''Esrai''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]], dark-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], Esrai served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] on board the modified [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Gamble]]'' during a mission to acquire supplies for use in the completion of the new Rebel base, [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. She [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the [[Starship/Legends|starship]], which had highly jury-rigged controls, alongside [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Denlan]], under the command of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Vanden Willard/Legends|Vanden Willard]], bringing the vessel to the uninhabited [[Eschaton system/Legends|Eschaton system]] were the it was to receive the coordinates at which to meet their suppliers. After receiving the coordinates however, Esrai noted a signal on the ships [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], that of an Imperial [[Imperial Customs Corvette|Light corvette]], which fired on the ''Gamble'' damaging it and causing the bridge's control console to explode. A piece of shrapnel from the explosion embedded itself in Esrai's head, covering her in [[Blood/Legends|blood]] and [[Death/Legends|killing]] her. Organa, who had been floored by the blast, checked Esrai's body for signs of life shortly afterwards and felt sick after seeing the Lieutenant's head wound. Organa would later dream of Esrai, imagining that she was speaking to the lieutenant in the [[Summer palace]] on the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], before an explosions which left Leia unaffected but with Esrai's blood on her hands. Whilst on the mission Esrai and the rest of the crew wore no [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] that would identify them as Rebels.<ref name="Razor's Edge" />

==Behind the scenes==
Esrai first appeared in ''[[Razor's Edge]]'' by [[Martha Wells]], released in [[2013]] as the first book in the ''[[Star Wars: Empire and Rebellion]]'' series of novels.
